results.title: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
results.original_title: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
results.overview: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

results.title: Hok Kolorob
results.overview: Inspired by a real-life tragedy, the story explores the shocking death of a fresher allegedly caused by ragging at a city university hostel, reopening wounds and igniting urgent conversations about abuse, accountability, and a system that failed to protect its own.

results.title: Censor Addiction
results.overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

results.title: Resan till Piemonte
results.overview: The film follows four newly retired people who travel to Italy to help Eva sell an olive farm she inherited. But during their sunny stay, new thoughts arise about life, freedom and the dreams they have yet to realize. The trip becomes a chance to reevaluate what really matters when you reach the second half of life.

results.title: Scammed
results.overview: Millions of Americans have fallen victim to a growing epidemic of online scams, from sextortion schemes aimed at teens to crypto investment scams targeting seniors.  FRONTLINE and Associated Press have spent more than a year investigating this shadowy world that's grown into a global criminal industry, powered in many cases by organized crime, trafficked labor, American technology, and, increasingly, Al.

results.title: Clementine Orange
results.overview: Angelica has fallen in love with John, a prisoner whose letters and photos have sparked fantasies of a dangerous, forbidden love. When John is granted a 24-hour release and they finally meet for the first time, her illusion shatters - John has catfished her. Despite the betrayal, Angelica decides to give him a chance, if only for those fleeting 24 hours.

results.title: 4th & 44
results.overview: Based on the life of Marty Reichman, who became the oldest college football player in American history at the age of 44.

results.title: Shikar
results.overview: Prakash, a simple family man, hires young advocate Parimita to secure bail for his friend Samir, who is accused of murdering his wife Asha and seven-year-old son Tanmay. As Parimita digs deeper into the case, hidden secrets and unexpected suspects begin to emerge. Every clue reveals a new layer of deception, turning the investigation into a dangerous maze of lies, betrayal, and mystery. With the truth becoming harder to uncover, Parimita must risk everything to expose the real culprit before she herself becomes trapped in the deadly conspiracy.

results.title: Hell Nation - The Story of Dead Kennedys
results.original_title: Hell Nation - The Story of Dead Kennedys
results.overview: On July the 19th, 1978, the Dead Kennedys would play their first show at the Mabuhay Gardens in San Francisco, California. This venue, also known as The Fab Mab was somewhat of a legendary venue.  It saw the likes of The Runaways, Ramones, The Dead Boys and even Motorhead stretch their strings there. So what better place for the Dead Kennedys to launch their assault onto the world.  The Dead Kennedys would be formed through The Recycler. A now legendary newspaper that brought many influential groups together. Metallica, Guns N Roses and Motley Crue all started from classified ads here.  Whilst of course the Kennedys were a full band, one man would essentially become the spokesperson for the group and his name would become synonymous with them. You can’t hear the name Jello Biafra without thinking of the politics behind Dead Kennedys.

results.title: Derail
results.overview: Renata exists through the gaze of others. Her routine is permeated by guilt, which invades the surreal landscape of her thoughts and reveals a strange obsession.

results.title: A Vast Algorithm of Humanity: The Movie
results.overview: Do-ah initiates a lawsuit against her husband's uncle who takes away a piece of land that her husband's grandfather left them. Do-ah decides to initiate the lawsuit, unable to stand by when the land and medicine business that her family has worked so hard to realize is stolen before her eyes. But she has no material evidence, and she knows nothing about legal procedures or what to do in court, leading to an extremely difficult situation for her. However in the midst of these troubles, she is reminded of the mysterious and rare treasure that can be used to solve any situation and to locate the expansive at land inside of her which she used to know.

results.title: Your Personal Taxi
results.overview: A one-of-a-kind classic taxi carries passengers with seemingly ordinary lives but extraordinary stories, each journey accompanied by a song of their choosing.

results.title: Balcanica
results.overview: Music has been banned in Afghanistan, and now an orchestra conductor and his son, a tuba player, attempt to start over by emigrating along the Balkan route. During their flight, seemingly endless, they cross paths with an Italian woman, a doctor. This encounter will change the two refugees’ lives and that of the young woman as well.

results.title: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy
results.original_title: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy
results.overview: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy follows 50-year-old Val (Tisha Campbell), a devoted wife and stay at home mom, who is eager to reignite the spark in her marriage when her youngest child leaves for college. Grappling with empty-nest feelings, loneliness and growing emotional distance from her husband Ross (Russell Hornsby), Val begins to realize that her marriage and the woman she once was, may be slipping away. A spontaneous escape to New Orleans to support her pregnant daughter, Kayla (Zing Ashford), awakens long-buried dreams and passions and introduces her to Peter Mosley (Mekhi Phifer), a handsome and charismatic photographer who sees her in ways she has forgotten to see herself. Reawakening her artistic spirit and rediscovering her worth, Val must face a life-altering question: is it ever too late to choose yourself and the love you truly deserve?

results.title: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy
results.original_title: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy
results.overview: Amanda Knox returns to Italy to confront Giuliano Mignini, the prosecutor who locked her up for a murder she did not commit

results.title: Twenty One Pilots: Southside Festival 2026
results.overview: Twenty One Pilots embody an alternative pop sound from Ohio. At the Southside Festival 2026, their emotionally charged sound meets the wide-open spaces of Neuhausen ob Eck: rap, rock and electronic music blend together to create a performance that focuses not only on spectacle, but also on movement, intensity and a close connection with the audience.

results.title: Viral
results.overview: During a live broadcast, a digital performer finds herself strangely alone in front of only one viewer.

results.title: Dog Day Evening
results.overview: A hostage situation occurred at a TV station. The kidnapper K was not after money, he just wanted to terminate the monthly subscription to the TV station.

results.title: Omega
results.overview: After surviving a catastrophic tsunami, Raven is exiled to a remote prison island inhabited by colossal creatures known as Omegas. But when a new terror emerges, she must stop history from repeating itself - even if it costs her freedom.

results.title: Phantom of the Opera
results.overview: We see the film, not the cinema; cinema remains hidden within the film. Cinema is the Phantom of the Opera. A movement and a moment of transition, the Phantom fades away with each opera. It disappears and then reemerges in another, and another, and another, and yet another opera.
